payload.reason: The evidence indicates that pre-trained embeddings significantly enhance the performance of NLP tasks, suggesting that their absence would likely lead to lower performance.

claims.text: Not having access to pre-trained embeddings would likely decrease the performance of the method, as they provide context-sensitive representations that improve accuracy.
The inclusion of LM embeddings improved performance on sequence tagging tasks, indicating that without them, the performance would be lower than the reported state of the art.
